title: Dam ɗin da ya karya Masarauta
intro: Ƙasa mai koguna masu gudana, lambuna biyu masu ganye, da wadata mara misaltuwa - amma mazaunanta sun yi sakaci ga Wanda ya albarkace su. Lokacin da tunatarwa ta zo ta dawo da su, sai suka juya baya. Abin da ya biyo baya shi ne hukunci wanda har yanzu yana amsawa a matsayin gargaɗi. Wanene wannan tsohuwar al'umma?
clues: Mun zauna a ƙasar da ta yi albarka sosai har gidanmu yana tsakanin lambuna biyu masu ganye.
Mun ji daɗin koguna suna gudana ta cikin ƙasashenmu da kuma yalwar amfanin gona da suka cika gidajenmu.
Duk da haka lokacin da aka kira mu zuwa ga godiya da biyayya ga Ubangijinmu, sai muka juya baya cikin girman kai.
Dukiyarmu da jin daɗinmu sun sa muka manta da Wanda ya ba mu komai.
Sai wata guguwa ta zo kwatsam wadda ta ratsa babban shingen da muka dogara da shi.
Mu ne mutanen Saba', waɗanda ƙasarsu ta shahara da babban madatsar ruwa ta Ma'rib.

trial.label: Faduwarmu
options: Ambaliyar ruwa daga fashewar madatsar ruwa
Tana ƙonewa a cikin ramin wuta
Nutsewa cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai girma
trial.answer: Ambaliyar ruwa daga fashewar madatsar ruwa

outcome.label: Ƙaddararmu
options: Lambuna biyu masu ɗaci sun maye gurbin lambunan mu masu kyau
Ƙasa ta nutse a ƙarƙashin teku
An binne mu a cikin tokar aman wuta
Al'ummarmu ta rabu gida goma sha biyu kabilai
outcome.answer: Lambuna biyu masu ɗaci sun maye gurbin lambunan mu masu kyau

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
